customer: Well, I finally decided to sell my midsize SUV to you folks here in California, and my daughter keeps asking me what happens to the license plates, and honestly I hadn't even thought about it. I've had those plates for years, retired now so I'm not in any rush, but I'd hate to leave them on and cause some mess later. Do I leave them on the car or take them with me, and what do I even do with them after?
agent: Great question, and it's smart to sort this out ahead of time! According to our article "What to do with your license plates," you'll want to remove the plates before you hand over the SUV and keep them with you. What happens with them after that is up to California's motor vehicle agency, but you can usually transfer them to your next car.
